criteria.statement: Production hygiene configuration constructs and wires a non-nil ContextVM response-backed HygieneObservationSource.
A canonical NIP-59 scan response from the addressed worker, correlated by exact request rumor e tag and JSON-RPC id, produces a Tier-1 quarantine intent.
A canonical NIP-59 pressure response above policy thresholds produces a garbage-collection intent.
Responses from another authenticated pubkey, with wrong correlation, or outside the required NIP-59 transport cannot authorize hygiene actions and provoke no Bahia response event.
Truncated scan results never supply quarantine candidates while independent pressure results remain eligible for garbage collection.
Request registration is race-safe, bounded, expiring, and ordered so older responses cannot replace newer component state.
